title: Ordering Coffee Your Way
meta: B2 · 约 250 词 · 场景：咖啡店定制点单与做错饮品

lines.en: Morning! What can I get started for you?
lines.zh: 早！想喝点什么？

lines.en: **Can I get a large latte with oat milk, please?**
lines.zh: 请给我一杯大杯燕麦奶拿铁。

lines.en: Sure. Oat milk is an extra eighty cents. Is that okay?
lines.zh: 好的。燕麦奶要加八毛钱，可以吗？

lines.en: That's fine. And could you __make it__ ==extra hot==? I've got a long walk to the office.
lines.zh: 没问题。能做得特别烫一点吗？我走到公司要挺久。

lines.en: No problem. Any ==syrup==? We have vanilla, caramel and hazelnut.
lines.zh: 没问题。要加糖浆吗？有香草、焦糖和榛子的。

lines.en: Just __half a pump__ of vanilla. I don't like it too sweet.
lines.zh: 香草的，只要半泵。我不喜欢太甜。

lines.en: Half a pump, got it. Would you like an extra ==shot==? It's quite a mild blend.
lines.zh: 半泵，记下了。要不要多加一份浓缩？我们这款豆子味道比较淡。

lines.en: Oh, yes, __go ahead__. I need it today. And one plain croissant, __for here__.
lines.zh: 哦，好，加吧。今天确实需要。再要一个原味可颂，在这儿吃。

lines.en: Alright, that's eight forty altogether. Can I get a name for the cup?
lines.zh: 好的，一共八块四。杯子上写什么名字？

lines.en: It's Lee. L, E, E. Can I pay by card?
lines.zh: Lee。L、E、E。能刷卡吗？

lines.en: Of course, just tap here whenever you're ready.
lines.zh: 当然，准备好了在这儿拍一下就行。

lines.en: Sorry, __excuse me__. I think this might be the wrong drink. It tastes like regular milk.
lines.zh: 不好意思，打扰一下。我觉得这杯可能做错了，喝着像普通牛奶。

lines.en: Oh, let me check the ==label==. You're right, this one's for another order. My apologies.
lines.zh: 哦，我看看标签。您说得对，这杯是别人的单。抱歉。

lines.en: No worries. I just can't have dairy, so I wanted to __double-check__.
lines.zh: 没关系。我只是不能喝乳制品，所以想确认一下。

lines.en: Totally understand. I'll ==remake== it now, oat milk, extra hot, half vanilla, extra shot.
lines.zh: 完全理解。我马上重做：燕麦奶、特别烫、半泵香草、多加一份浓缩。

lines.en: **That's the one. Could you also put a lid on it? I'll take it to go after all.**
lines.zh: 就是这个。能帮我加个盖子吗？我还是打包带走吧。

lines.en: Sure thing. And since you had to wait, the croissant is ==on the house== today.
lines.zh: 没问题。让您久等了，今天可颂算我们请的。

lines.en: Oh, you don't have to do that. But thank you, that's really nice of you.
lines.zh: 哎，不用这样的。不过谢谢，你人真好。

lines.en: Here you go. Careful, it's very hot. Have a good day at work!
lines.zh: 给您。小心，很烫。祝您上班顺利！

lines.en: **Thanks, you too. See you tomorrow.**
lines.zh: 谢谢，你也是。明天见。

gist.q: 「你」点的咖啡有哪些定制要求？
gist.a: 大杯燕麦奶拿铁，特别烫，半泵香草糖浆，多加一份浓缩。

gist.q: 拿到咖啡后出了什么问题？「你」为什么特别在意？
gist.a: 拿错成别人的普通牛奶拿铁；因为「你」不能喝乳制品。

gist.q: 咖啡师最后怎么处理的？
gist.a: 按要求重做一杯，并且那个可颂免费送了。

prompts.q: 你在咖啡店想点一杯冰美式，但要少冰、不加糖，另外问问有没有低咖啡因的选项。用 30 秒点单。
prompts.ref: Hi, can I get an iced Americano, please? Less ice, and no sugar or syrup at all. Actually, do you have a decaf option? I've already had two coffees today. If you do, I'll go with decaf. And could I get it in a medium size? Thanks.
prompts.ref_zh: 你好，请给我一杯冰美式。少冰，完全不要糖或糖浆。对了，你们有低咖啡因的吗？我今天已经喝了两杯咖啡了。有的话我就换低因的。中杯就行，谢谢。

prompts.q: 你在外卖平台点的咖啡送到后发现是热的，而你点的是冰的。打电话给店里，说明情况并提出你想怎么处理。
prompts.ref: Hi, I just got a delivery from your shop under the name Lee. I ordered an iced latte, but this one is hot. I think the order got mixed up. Would it be possible to send the right one, or could you refund the drink instead? Either is fine with me, I just want to sort it out.
prompts.ref_zh: 你好，我刚收到你们店的外卖，名字是 Lee。我点的是冰拿铁，送来的是热的，应该是弄混了。能重新送一杯对的吗？或者这杯给我退款也行。两种都可以，我就是想把事情处理好。
